Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Interface CreativeNode

All Known Implementing Classes:
CreativeGroup, CreativeItem
public sealed interface CreativeNode permits CreativeGroup, CreativeItem
An element directly inside a creative category: either a CreativeGroup (a collapsible group with an icon), or a CreativeItem that is not in any group ("loose").

Use pattern matching to tell them apart: 


 switch (node) {
     case CreativeGroup group -> ...
     case CreativeItem item -> ...
 }
Neither knows which category or group it is in; ask the CreativeLayout or CreativeEditor instead. That way an element can never disagree with the layout about where it is.
